name: Cryptid Campaign Manager
source:
A big-shot political campaign manager fallen from grace, you're forced into early retirement and relocated to Pine Pass, VT. Just as you're settling in, the mayor's sudden resignation awakens the sleepy town and has cryptid candidates Big Foot, La Llorona, and the Lich King at your doorstep. Help them earn the votes of the people and win their hearts along the way!

[from [url=https://agehabutterfly.itch.io/cryptid-campaign-manager]itch.io[/url]]
